---
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md"
---

# Architecture documentation

- Document responsibility, inputs/outputs, state, provenance, validation, and
  limitations where applicable.
- Keep Library (knowledge memory), Data Base (recorded world state), and
  Institute (research) distinct; document decision authority boundaries.
- Clearly distinguish implemented contracts from target architecture and
  planned capabilities. Do not claim nonexistent engines, registries, schemas,
  workflows, or test commands exist.
- Keep architecture documentation consistent with the repository's actual
  Python package and tests; do not prescribe empty directory scaffolding.
